caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four long, curved legs and a dark brown finish. The table features a rectangular top and has five drawers on the front: two small drawers at the top, a slightly larger central drawer beneath them, and two medium-sized drawers below each small top drawer. Each drawer is equipped with yellow or gold-colored ornate handles. The central bottom drawer is decorated with a carved shell-like motif. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with some faint stains or discolorations on the paper. The artist's signature, "A. Johnson," appears in small text near the lower left corner.
title: Lowboy
